It brought in $203,106 of gross profit (ref: [IS_2026-06.xlsx]Service!C20). That is 10.9% of the company's Q2 gross profit of $1,865,328 (inputs: [IS_2026-06.xlsx]Service!C20, [IS_2026-06.xlsx]Total!C20).

The other two units ranked lower on margin but made more gross profit:

| Unit | Gross margin | Gross profit |
|---|---|---|
| Service | 46.1% | $203,106 |
| Online | 38.2% (ref: [IS_2026-06.xlsx]Online!C21) | $612,585 (ref: [IS_2026-06.xlsx]Online!C20) |
| Wholesale | 22.3% (ref: [IS_2026-06.xlsx]Wholesale!C21) | $1,049,637 (ref: [IS_2026-06.xlsx]Wholesale!C20) |

Service has the smallest share of the three because its net sales are only $440,689 (ref: [IS_2026-06.xlsx]Service!C13).
